description: This PHP file defines a console command class 'PHPFixCodingStandardsCommand' that extends Symfony's Command class. The command runs the PHP CS Fixer tool to automatically fix coding standards issues in the project files, with options to reset cache and specify PHP executable.

classes.name: PHPFixCodingStandardsCommand
classes.description: A console command class that runs PHP CS Fixer to automatically fix code style issues, with options for cache reset and PHP executable specification.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's description, help message, and options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the PHP CS Fixer process, handles cache reset logic, outputs fixed files, and returns status.
